title: He Hung Up On One Question

beats.text: It's two in the morning and Dave is one tap from paying nine thousand nine hundred ninety seven dollars to a man he met on a webinar.
Three weeks earlier a mansion guy said I made a million dollars last year.
The F T C says one program like this pulled in more than one hundred twenty five million dollars.
Dave watched the free training and by minute ten he'd seen the mansion the car and a jet ski but still no secret.
Then a timer hit and nineteen spots became one so he paid the workshop fee. One thousand nine hundred ninety seven dollars.
Day two the real system turned out to live in Platinum like a game that never lets you reach the castle.
Dave searched the mansion photo. Just a rental you can book by the night.
He searched the guru's one business and it was the course itself.
The F T C's own words. The primary thing MOBE sells is more MOBE memberships.
Do the math. Sell that workshop to a thousand people and it's almost two million dollars even if nobody earns a cent.
Dave asked for a refund. The risk free guarantee turned into three replies and zero dollars back.
So he called his coach and asked the one question that matters. What did your typical student actually earn after paying.
Silence. Then I have another call. Click.
Dave closed the Platinum tab. Nine thousand nine hundred ninety seven dollars saved.
That question ends every pitch like this and Dave's full fight to win his money back is one tap away in the video linked below.
